create.name: Jamye Price
create.bio:
Jamye Price is a channel and energy-work teacher who has lived in Sedona, Arizona, since 2010. Her own account traces a gradual opening that began in the late 1980s with intuitive impressions, grew through the 1990s, and by the early 2000s included Light Language, a flowing, wordless form of spoken, sung and written expression that she treats as communication from the soul and from non-physical guides. She began channelling for groups in 2005 and later started speaking for a collective she calls Areon, the Lyran Council of Time.

She has taught Light Language since 2014, mainly through live online programmes on Zoom: a foundations course over two weekends and a longer accelerator with a practice community. She also runs self-paced year-long courses such as Freeing Your Heart, and she trains practitioners in Crystalline Soul Healing, a method she developed in 2003 and has taught in Japan and the United States. Her book Opening to Light Language sets out her understanding of the practice, and she published the Cosmic Consciousness Ascension Deck. Each month she posts a free video on the energies of the coming weeks, with a Light Language transmission, on her YouTube channel.

books.title: Opening to Light Language: Humanity's Evolution into Multidimensional Communication
books.author: Jamye Price
books.description: Her study of Light Language as a form of communication with subtle realms, setting out how she understands it and how readers might begin to open to it themselves. It also draws on recent scientific ideas that she sees as relevant.

courses.title: Learn Light Language
courses.description: Live online training on Zoom in two parts: Foundations, over two weekends, covers speaking, writing, singing and signing Light Language, and the seven-week Accelerator adds weekly calls, translation practice and a student community. Places are limited and the current round is sold out.

courses.title: Freeing Your Heart
courses.description: A self-paced online course in twelve steps, with a year of access. Each step pairs a channelled message from Areon with her own teaching, a Light Language transmission and simple exercises.

courses.title: Elevate Your Creative Harmonic
courses.description: A self-paced online course with a year of access, combining teachings, channelled messages, energy sessions and exercises on clarifying intention and creative expression.

free_resources.title: Pick a Galactic Card
free_resources.description: A free online card draw from her Cosmic Consciousness Ascension Deck: take a breath, ask a question and choose a card to read its message.

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube @JamyePrice 31.2k subscribers (channel header, read 4 Nov 2026); Instagram, Facebook and X not read (we do not open instagram.com or facebook.com; X needs a login) → ~31k counted → local_hero
flags: No Shift mention on own site: listed without the link (home, about, classes, contact, course and shop pages read 4 Nov 2026).
Tier counts unreadable for Instagram, Facebook and X (main accounts); with ~31k on YouTube alone she is very likely still under 100k, but a human may want to check.
Base: her about page says she moved to Sedona in 2010, and her contact page gives a Sedona, AZ business mailing address (Crystalline Soul Healing, LLC); recorded at city level only.

Book: her own site links two Amazon ASINs (B01BECUR0K ebook, B0DDM23TLC print); I used the print ASIN as linked by her. No ISBN was published, so it could not be confirmed on Open Library, ; cover is the 3D book image from her own book page.
Her private-sessions page carries a client testimonial about weight loss and back healing; sessions are currently unavailable and are not listed.
Contact page asks for event booking enquiries by email but the address is not shown in the page text, so the contact form is used.
Facebook account is named Crystalline Soul Healing (her company) but linked from her site footer; not opened.
left_out: Learn Crystalline Soul Healing ($1295 USD training): its page says the template heals trauma and genetic patterning, which is borderline under the health rule, so left out.
Private sessions (Crystalline Soul Healing, Axiatonal Alignment): currently unavailable, and the page carries health-claim testimonials.
The Channel Panel event (13–15 November, West Palm Beach and online): someone else's event reached through a referral link; not opened.
Feminine Fire Telesummit: a third-party free summit.
Monthly Ascension Energies videos: dated forecasts, not evergreen; Portuguese-dubbed uploads and Shorts left out.
Cosmic Consciousness Ascension Deck ($34.99): no ISBN published, so not listed as a book.
Light Language Audio downloads: the shop page groups them as audio programmes for health, with a Health Series, so left out under the health rule.
